## Conservative language check

- [ ] Keeps local-first behavior clear.
- [ ] Avoids production readiness, production legal advice, compliance, ESG, or certified reporting claims.
- [ ] Describes sustainability values as proxy, counterfactual, estimated, and methodology-dependent when relevant.
- [ ] Notes fixture-backed/default-local behavior where relevant.
- [ ] Does not imply telemetry, update checks, cloud calls, or external lookup unless a future scoped feature explicitly adds them.
